## Learning Objectives (ECO Alignment)
By the end of this chapter, you will be able to:
1. Identify and create different R object types (Vectors, Data Frames).
2. Use functions and arguments to manipulate data.
3. Install and load R packages via the Tidyverse.
:::

# Introduction to R
R is more than a calculator; it is an object-oriented language. In Data Science, we store our data in objects so we can transform and visualize them efficiently.
